criteriaLedger.week: sales base is calendar major +1 (2026-08-31 => 36), then base+1/+2/+3; each exposes subweek 01/02/03. Explicit pasted forms such as 21차, 21-1, 21-2차, 21-3차, the common typo 20-1치, and flight-marked 20-1A/20-1B are recognized; A/B remains a logistics flight suffix and both preserve numeric OrderWeek 20-01 rather than reinterpreting B as subweek 02. A detected week takes precedence only within the available base~+3 choices, and year-qualified input must match the same OrderYear.
criteriaLedger.manager: defaults to authenticated userName when that manager exists; selected display name is resolved to active UserInfo.UserID before OrderMaster write
criteriaLedger.customer: explicit selected CustKey is authoritative; pasted customer text cannot redirect the write; customer shortcut cards wrap onto additional rows instead of remaining in one horizontally clipped row
criteriaLedger.matching: normalize line-ending backslash delimiters before parsing so every quantity row is retained; normalize explicit 대 and st (case-insensitive, with or without whitespace) to canonical 송이 without changing the numeric quantity, so 5대 and 5st both mean exactly 5송이 across upload, rule parsing, LLM result normalization, quantity-line counting, and product-name cleanup; use accuracy-first claude-sonnet-4-5 (ORDER_PASTE_LLM_MODEL override allowed) and compare LLM/rule item coverage against the explicit quantity-line count, preferring LLM on an equally complete result and rules when LLM over-produces; ERP Product spellings and confirmed aliases must feed the LLM candidate query (including ALSTROMERIA Dubai/Fifi/Whistler). Korean typos use token-level Hangul jamo similarity only inside the existing country, flower-family, and size/spec safeguards; ambiguous near-top candidates remain manual review instead of auto-selection. Explicit pasted box/bunch/stem units must survive LLM parsing instead of being replaced by inferred Product defaults; return parseSource/count/model diagnostics and show the unaggregated AI-recognized customer/item/quantity/match rows in a persistent side preview; allocate wide dedicated columns to inputName and the matched ERP product; show up to three next-ranked candidates from the same shared matching engine inline and persist a clicked candidate through the existing mapping-only API; a More button opens a search field plus the remaining ranked /api/products/search candidates and each result also applies immediately; each row keeps the analyzed default unit selected, exposes only box/bunch/stem units that the FormOrderAdd conversion factors can convert to Product.OutUnit, and recalculates current/final display in OutUnit after a unit change; record analyze start/success/failure to AppLog category sales-paste-analysis without raw order text; unmatched, nonpositive, mixed-unit, or unconvertible rows block the whole write
criteriaLedger.currentOrder: exact OrderYear + OrderWeek + CustKey product quantities load before analysis and reload after verified commit; changed products appear first in the current-order panel with red before-to-after quantity and delta highlighting, and the last verified change remains visible after commit
criteriaLedger.write: source=sales-paste uses my-customer optimistic-lock ADD policy and post-write ViewOrder verification; the visible live operation log records start, DB request, per-row server results, reload, completion, and failure while the button operation is running
criteriaLedger.stock: ADD retains the existing FormOrderAdd-compatible stock calculation/warning path; it must not perform a direct manual stock adjustment
criteriaLedger.forbidden: never call shipment adjust/distribute APIs and never create or update ShipmentMaster, ShipmentDetail, ShipmentDate, ShipmentFarm, Estimate or profit ledgers
